heading: INT. DEEP-SPACE STATION KESTREL - HYDROPONICS RING - STATION NIGHT

units.text: INT. DEEP-SPACE STATION KESTREL - HYDROPONICS RING - STATION NIGHT
A curved corridor of glass tubes, each holding a glowing green column of algae.
The air is thick and humid and smells faintly of cut grass.
Beyond the observation glass, a gas giant turns, banded in rust and ochre.
DR. SOLEDAD MARSH, 40s, in a lab coat with its sleeves rolled, kneels at a sample port and draws a vial of green fluid.
PAVEL IONESCU, 30s, a technician with a shaved head and a tool belt, stands on a ladder adjusting a pump housing, his headlamp swinging as he talks.
Flow's down again. Eight percent.
units.name: PAVEL

units.text: It's always eight percent.
units.name: SOLEDAD

units.text: Which is why it's not a coincidence.
units.name: PAVEL

units.text: She caps the vial and holds it to the light.

Pavel climbs down, wipes his hands on a rag, and joins her at the port, and for a moment they both look into the green column as it breathes, slow, bubbling, almost alive, while the gas giant's light slides across their faces.
Pavel. Do you hear that?
units.name: SOLEDAD

units.text: The pump?
units.name: PAVEL

units.text: Under the pump.
units.name: SOLEDAD

units.text: He tilts his head.
Beneath the hum of machinery, a faint rhythmic tapping, like fingers on glass.
The hatch at the end of the corridor opens.
COMMANDER HANNE LINDGREN, 50s, in a gray jacket with silver epaulettes, a tablet in her hand, steps through.
Her face is composed.
Her eyes move over the tubes.
Doctor Marsh. Mister Ionescu. Please stop what you're doing.
units.name: HANNE

units.text: Commander. We were just --
units.name: SOLEDAD

units.text: I know what you were doing. I read your logs.
units.name: HANNE

units.text: Is something wrong?
units.name: PAVEL

units.text: Yes.
units.name: HANNE

units.text: She lifts the tablet.
On its screen, a schematic of the ring pulses red.
The culture in tube nine is not algae. It stopped being algae three days ago.
units.name: HANNE

units.text: Then what is it?
units.name: SOLEDAD

units.text: We were hoping you would tell us.
units.name: HANNE

units.text: At the far end, the tapping on the glass grows louder.
All three turn.
